title: Nearest symbol
description:
Turn an address into `function+offset` with a symbol table.

```
symbols: main 0x1000, parse 0x1080, render 0x1200
0x1094 -> parse+0x14
0x1200 -> render
0x0800 -> unknown (before the first symbol)
```
hints: The symbol before `upper_bound`'s result is the nearest one at or below the address (lesson 5.04).
Print the offset only when it is not zero.
requirements: Sort the symbols by address and look up with `std::upper_bound`.
An address past the end of the last function (if sizes are known) is unknown.
Read symbols from a text file in the form `address name size`.
stretch: Demangle C++ names in your table with `UnDecorateSymbolName` (Windows) or `abi::__cxa_demangle` (GCC).
